newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat tradeless on weather, pools uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat tradeless on weather, pools uncertainty.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures did not trade on Friday as the market pondered effects of forecast dry weather and a possible pool price cut next week.
Settlement prices edged up in nearer-term contracts but were steady in more distant contracts.

Australia's Bureau of Meteorology said earlier in the week that Australia faced the prospect of a dry winter and spring because of a continued El Nino weather effect. Australian wheat needs follow-up rain to establish a good 1997/98 crop.
As well, Chicago price slide raised local speculation that the Australian Wheat Board will cut pool prices on Monday.
